a newer link replaces the older one; the older one sets nothing
a used link changes nothing
an expired link changes nothing

W02.title: Sign-in refusals, lockout, session rotation and sign-out

steps.name: set a password for a staff member

signing in starts a new session identifier; an identifier held before never becomes signed in
signing out ends the session on the server
a visitor sent to sign in from a protected page returns to that page after signing in
sign-in never redirects to another site, whatever next= says
